name: Rezarus
description:
About This Game

Step into the cockpit of Rezarus and experience a pulse-pounding fusion of retro aesthetics and firepower built on a modern game engine. Seize control points, capture enemy flags stations, and outmaneuver and outduel your foes. Your mission is simple: destroy the enemy before they destroy you.

🌐 Online: First-person tank arena combat game, teams of 3–10 players go up against one another in arcade-style warfare—with every keystroke determining victory or defeat.

⌨️ Revolutionary keyboard-only controls: Say goodbye to boring copypasta twitchy mouse-aiming and hello to precision maneuvers that reward the dance of mastering both your tank's position and turret aim. Every movement is mapped to your keys, creating a tactile battlefield experience that grows deeper and more rewarding the longer you play. Whether you’re coordinating a pincer in Capture the Flag or holding the line on a contested control point, keyboard tactics become your ultimate weapon—something no other first-person tank combat game can touch. Once you master them, you'll never be able to go back to a mouse-controlled tank combat game again.

Four Electrifying Game Modes

🚀Total Wars CTF: Unleash chaos with an arsenal of tanks and weapons at your fingertips. Seize control points, capture enemy flags, and wage all-out war by any means necessary—whether you rain shells from afar or charge headlong into the fray. In Total Wars CTF, victory belongs to the bold and the relentless.

🚀Laser Wars: Streamlined and simplified, yet tactical as ever. Each player commands a single tank equipped with a laser cannon, plus one customizable module to tweak your playstyle. With perfectly balanced loadouts, teamwork and coordination are everything—so lock in with your squad and execute flawless flanks.

🚀Phoenix Wars: Two shots; one chance to reign supreme. This mode strips combat back to raw FPS fundamentals: lead your target, dodge incoming fire, and prove your sharpshooting prowess. Every engagement tests your reflexes and decision-making—survive the heat, and you’ll rise from the ashes like a true Phoenix.

🚀Impulse Wars: Gravity is your deadliest weapon. Instead of chasing kills, you’ll mastermind physics: push your opponents towards towering ledges, launch them off ramps, and watch them tumble into oblivion. Impulse Wars rewrites the rules of engagement—outsmart your foes and let physics do the rest.

Early Access

Join us in Early Access! After extensive alpha testing and with core gameplay fully in place, we’re opening up the gates so you can help us fine-tune server performance for bigger online battles. Your feedback will help guide future optimizations that ensure not only smooth larger-scale combat, but also fun. Your participation will help shape Rezarus’s future along with the rest of the community passionate about bringing back the fun in arcade style tank warfare.

🎯 Hop onto Rezarus today and be among the first to redefine tank warfare! It's free and there's no account registration necessary!

Indie by Design, AAA in Ambition

Rezarus is the passion project of a solo developer and dedicated closed-alpha testing community. Don’t let “indie” fool you—Rezarus already provides an online experience that stands up to big-budget blockbusters. Smaller team, bigger heart: creative freedom fuels innovation here, making your arcade-style tank warfare experience truly one-of-a-kind!
